title: WTShiftBench, a cancer-dependency-anchored benchmark resource for auditing endpoint-aligned recovery by transcriptomic perturbation models
description: WTShiftBench is a cancer-dependency-anchored benchmark resource for auditing endpoint-aligned recovery by transcriptomic perturbation models. This release includes source-data manifests, resource registries, active manuscript figure source data, artifact hashes, scripts and documentation for reproducing the active Figure 1-4 and Extended Data Figure 1-6 panel bundle.
